neighbours.label: the words ' remote', ' service' and ' instance' (any sense)
fire: We drove for hours to reach a remote cabin in the mountains.
Please log in to the remote machine and check the disk.
The bus service was cancelled because of the snow.
They called the support service to report the outage.
For instance, many birds migrate south each autumn.
Each instance of the database runs on its own server.
She grabbed the remote and turned off the television.
The memorial service was held at the old chapel.
quiet: We drove for hours to reach a quiet cabin in the mountains.
Please log in to the other machine and check the disk.
The bus route was cancelled because of the snow.
They called the support desk to report the outage.
For example, many birds migrate south each autumn.
Each copy of the database runs on its own server.
She grabbed the cushion and turned off the television.
The memorial gathering was held at the old chapel.

notes: Broad leak-regime pole (max 1.15). Probes: ' remote' fired in a non-computing sentence (remote village) as strongly as in SSH; ' service' and ' instance' ~0.4-0.55.
